title: 机器学习 · 数据划分与模型验证
description: 原创练习，按实际项目使用。20 句练习介绍数据泄漏、模型选择、类别不平衡、校准、外部验证及解释边界。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: The test set should remain separate during model development.
sentences.zh: 模型开发期间，测试集应保持独立。
sentences.note: remain separate 表示持续保持分离状态；during model development 说明适用阶段。
sentences.question: When would you first inspect the test set results?

sentences.en: Preprocessing parameters should be learned from the training data only.
sentences.zh: 预处理参数应仅从训练数据中学习得到。
sentences.note: should be learned 使用被动语态；only 限定参数学习的数据来源。
sentences.question: Which preprocessing steps learn parameters from the data?

sentences.en: Information leakage can make validation performance appear unrealistically strong.
sentences.zh: 信息泄漏可能让验证表现显得好得不真实。
sentences.note: make something appear 加形容词，表达某种表象；can 保留具体情境下的可能性。
sentences.question: What is one possible source of leakage in your workflow?

sentences.en: Samples from one individual should stay within the same partition.
sentences.zh: 来自同一个体的样本应保留在同一数据分区内。
sentences.note: from one individual 修饰 samples；within the same partition 表示避免个体信息跨分区泄漏。
sentences.question: How would you split repeated samples from individual participants?

sentences.en: A temporal split can evaluate predictions on later observations.
sentences.zh: 按时间划分可以评估模型对较晚观测的预测表现。
sentences.note: temporal 表示与时间有关；on later observations 说明评估的数据来自较晚时段。
sentences.question: Would a temporal split fit your intended prediction task?

sentences.en: Cross-validation estimates performance under the chosen resampling scheme.
sentences.zh: 交叉验证估计的是所选重采样方案下的模型表现。
sentences.note: under the chosen scheme 明确性能估计依赖的设计；estimates 不表示保证未来表现。
sentences.question: Why did you choose that cross-validation scheme?

sentences.en: Nested validation separates parameter tuning from the outer performance evaluation.
sentences.zh: 嵌套验证将参数调优与外层性能评估分开。
sentences.note: separate A from B 表示分离两项工作；outer 指嵌套结构中的外层。
sentences.question: What role does the inner validation loop serve?

sentences.en: Feature selection belongs inside the training process for each split.
sentences.zh: 每次数据划分中的特征选择都应在训练流程内部完成。
sentences.note: belongs inside 表示应归入某个范围；for each split 强调要对每次划分分别执行。
sentences.question: Where does feature selection occur in your validation procedure?

sentences.en: A simple baseline helps establish whether added complexity is useful.
sentences.zh: 简单的基线模型有助于判断增加复杂度是否有用。
sentences.note: whether 引出待回答的问题；added complexity 指更复杂模型带来的额外复杂度。
sentences.question: Which baseline would provide a fair comparison for your model?

sentences.en: Class imbalance can make overall accuracy a misleading summary.
sentences.zh: 类别不平衡可能使总体准确率成为具有误导性的概括。
sentences.note: make A B 使用名词作宾语补足语；overall 限定这里指总体准确率。
sentences.question: Which metric would complement accuracy for an imbalanced dataset?

sentences.en: Precision depends on prevalence as well as model performance.
sentences.zh: 精确率既取决于模型表现，也取决于阳性比例。
sentences.note: depend on 表示取决于；as well as 并列两个因素。分类任务中的 precision 指精确率。
sentences.question: Why might precision change in a different population?

sentences.en: Recall measures the proportion of actual positives identified by the model.
sentences.zh: 召回率衡量模型识别出的阳性占实际阳性的比例。
sentences.note: the proportion of 明确这里衡量比例；actual positives 是分母，identified by the model 限定其中被识别的部分。
sentences.question: When is missing a positive case especially costly?

sentences.en: Choosing a decision threshold requires considering the costs of different errors.
sentences.zh: 选择决策阈值需要考虑不同错误的代价。
sentences.note: Choosing 加名词构成动名词主语；requires considering 表示决策时需要考虑的因素，不预设阈值已正确反映代价。
sentences.question: How would the intended application affect your decision threshold?

sentences.en: Calibration compares predicted probabilities with observed frequencies of the outcome.
sentences.zh: 校准比较预测概率与实际观测到的结局频率。
sentences.note: compare A with B 用来介绍比较对象；probabilities 与 frequencies 区分预测值和观测频率。
sentences.question: Why does probability calibration matter for decision making?

sentences.en: Good discrimination does not guarantee that predicted probabilities are calibrated.
sentences.zh: 良好的区分能力并不保证预测概率经过良好校准。
sentences.note: does not guarantee 后接 that 从句；discrimination 与 calibration 是不同的性能维度。
sentences.question: How would you distinguish discrimination from calibration?

chunks.zh: 预测概率经过良好校准

sentences.en: External validation examines performance in data collected outside the development setting.
sentences.zh: 外部验证考察模型在开发环境之外收集的数据上的表现。
sentences.note: collected 是过去分词，修饰 data；outside 明确与开发环境之间的区分。
sentences.question: What makes a validation dataset external to your development data?

sentences.en: Distribution shifts can weaken performance when the deployment population changes.
sentences.zh: 部署人群发生变化时，分布偏移可能削弱模型表现。
sentences.note: when 引导情境从句；can weaken 表示可能影响，不能据此认定所有偏移都有相同后果。
sentences.question: Which population changes could affect your model after deployment?

chunks.zh: 当部署人群发生变化时

sentences.en: Feature importance describes model behavior rather than proving a biological mechanism.
sentences.zh: 特征重要性描述模型的行为，并不能证明生物学机制。
sentences.note: rather than proving 对照两种解释；model behavior 将重要性限定在模型层面。
sentences.question: How would you present an important feature without making a causal claim?

sentences.en: Correlated features can share predictive information and complicate importance rankings.
sentences.zh: 相关特征可能共享预测信息，使重要性排序更复杂。
sentences.note: share 和 complicate 是共用 can 的并列谓语；rankings 指特征的相对排序。
sentences.question: How might correlated features affect your interpretation of importance?

sentences.en: We should report performance uncertainty alongside the chosen evaluation metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们应在报告所选评估指标的同时，报告性能的不确定性。
sentences.note: alongside 表示共同呈现；chosen evaluation metrics 提醒读者指标经过选择且需要说明。
sentences.question: How would you communicate uncertainty in model performance?
